claims.summary: For X_1..X_N i.i.d. uniform on [0,1]^2 and D(f) = sum_i f(X_i) - N int f, with probability at least 1 - 1/N: (a) for every integer k in [1, N] and every two down-sets A, B of the grid of k x k cells of side 1/k (unions of cells closed under moving a cell down or left), |D(1_A) - D(1_B)| <= sqrt(2 N area(A sym B) u_k) + (4/3) u_k, u_k = 2 log(2N) + 2k ln 4; (b) for real weights w_i and pairs (A_i, B_i) of down-sets of one grid, |D(sum w_i 1_(A_i)) - D(sum w_i 1_(B_i))| <= sum over A_i != B_i of |w_i| (sqrt(2 N alpha_i u_k) + (4/3) u_k), alpha_i = area(A_i sym B_i); (c) at the Leighton-Shor mesh k = 1/W = 2^(l_1), for N large, each term is at most sqrt(6 N alpha_i / W) + 4/W.
claims.assessment: Working proof: Bernstein's inequality for f = 1_A - 1_B (|Y_i| <= 2, variance at most the area of A sym B) with a union over the at most 16^k pairs of down-sets of each grid (binom(2k, k) <= 4^k monotone boundary paths) and over k <= N; the step of lem:guided-chain-bound (b) with the variance taken as the area instead of P(S)^2/2, the technique of cor:translate-staircase-stacks's union over staircases. On bands between two lattice down-sets it is sharper than lem:guided-chain-bound (a) at a coarse mesh near the band's area only below area about W log N.
claims.rationale: An elementary bound on a set's deviation from another lattice down-set by the band's area, of order sqrt N at area W; for the theorem's target range lem:guided-chain-bound (a) at a coarse mesh suffices, and the lemma sharpens the band term below area about W log N.
claims.next_action: None for the target range; use it where bands of area below W log N need a term below sqrt(N log N).

claims.summary: At (4,4), on the events of thm:offset-tree-stacks (c), of lem:guided-chain-bound at kappa = 1 and of lem:lattice-band-perturbation, for N large: for every lattice down-set with profile phi_0, every K >= 2, m >= 1, n = ceil(log_2 K), (c)'s offsets c_i = 2W sum_(1<=j<=i) 2^(nu(j)), D_i° = {s < phi_0(t) - c_i}, and every nested chain of lattice down-sets D_0 >= ... >= D_(K-1) with area(D_i sym D_i°) <= alpha_i, if 2^n W(n+1) <= 2, g = m W y* sum_(i<K) 1_(D_i) has discrete cost at most 2 and every boundary of D_i has grid length at least l_0 > 0, then with v = m y* >= 2e^16, a = K W v <= 8 l_0^(-1)(log(v/2))^(-1/4) and alpha-bar_i = max(alpha_i, W): |D(g)| <= C sqrt(N log N)(1 + l_0^(-1)(1 + ln(n+1)(log(v/2))^(-1/4))) + C sqrt N l_0^(-1)(1 + ln(n+1))^(7/4)(log(v/2))^(-1/4) + (a/K) sum over D_i != D_i° of min{sqrt(6 N alpha_i / W) + 4/W, C sqrt N ((log_2(alpha-bar_i/W) + 1)^(3/4) + sqrt(log N))}; at the target when ln(n+1) <= (log(v/2))^(1/4) and log_2(max_i alpha-bar_i / W) <= (log N)^(2/3)(log(v/2))^(1/3).
claims.assessment: Working proof: D(g) = D(g°) + h sum_i (D(1_(D_i)) - D(1_(D_i°))) with g° the hierarchical translate stack; thm:offset-tree-stacks (a) with (c)'s cylinder tree and beta bounds for g°, whose only uses of cost and grid lengths are the bound on a and v <= 8/W^2, read from g by lem:fine-grid-leighton-shor (c); each band by the minimum of lem:lattice-band-perturbation and lem:guided-chain-bound (a) at the coarse mesh in [max(alpha_i, W), 2 max(alpha_i, W)), with the covering count area/W'^2 + 4/W' (cells inside the band, and at most 2/W' cells whose interior a monotone boundary path meets).
claims.rationale: Decides the fourteenth review's decisive instance on its first reading (zigzag dividers about a hierarchical translate stack) at the target under (c)'s condition, a composition of two recorded statements; extends thm:offset-tree-stacks (c) from translates to every chain within band area W 2^((log N)^(2/3)(log(v/2))^(1/3)) of a hierarchical translate stack.
claims.next_action: The fourteenth review's two-level ramp-of-ramps sketch as a lemma, with pieces of distinct shapes (each a hierarchical translate stack, or near one) in place of its blocks; then pieces at gaps of unbounded ratio.
